cases.name: Christina "Christi" S. Marto Spicuzza
cases.narrative:
According to County Homicide detectives, crew tried to rob her, then held her captive for almost an hour, while Christi begged for her life. Detectives say Christi’s dashcam recording shows Crew pressing a gun to her head, and Christi saying, “I’m begging you, I have four kids.” The camera stopped when police say Crew grabbed it. Channel 11 asked police if they knew what happened in those moments.

“We do not know exactly what was happening at that time, but I’m sure it was terrifying for Christina,” Assistant Superintendent Vic Joseph said.

Eventually, police say, he took her into the woods in Monroeville, shot her in the head and executed her.

cases.name: Rochella Anderson
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative:
Officers found him standing outside the Rodeway Inn, covered in blood. They checked the motel room and found her "badly mutilated" body underneath a bed. He had allegedly stabbed her several times, scalped her and removed her teeth. Some of her teeth and scalp were found in a trash can in the bathroom.

When police arrived, he was bleeding from his left hand, and he was taken to the hospital for treatment. While there, he was asked by doctors about the injury and told them he had been “choking” his girlfriend, according to the criminal complaint.
